claude.text:
# AUB HANDOFF Analysis

## Champion Assessment

| Metric | Value | Status |
|--------|-------|--------|
| OOS Mean | 1.88 | ✅ Excellent |
| OOS Min | 0.43 | ⚠️ Below 0.55 threshold |
| Exposure | 0.47–0.84 | ✅ Acceptable |
| Degenerate Folds | 0 | ✅ Clean |

**Diagnosis:** Strong mean performance but weak floor suggests regime-specific fragility. One or more folds significantly underperforming.

---

## Next Commands

```
aub diag fold-breakdown --lane 21b5700bf9943671 --show-worst 3
aub sweep --base db08d79b484756ab --param l2_reg --range 0.001,0.01,0.05,0.1 --target oos_min
aub ablate --base db08d79b484756ab --mode sequential --metric oos_min
```

---

## Rationale

1. **fold-breakdown**: Identify which fold(s) drag oos_min to 0.43—need visibility before intervention
2. **l2_reg sweep**: Regularization often lifts worst-case performance at modest cost to mean
3. **ablate**: Check if specific features cause regime overfitting; removing them may improve floor

**Goal:** Lift oos_min above 0.55 while preserving mean > 1.5
